Medical Intelligence Summit

## The annual forum shaping the future of medicine.

Once a year, the people building the future of diagnostics gather in one place. The Medical Intelligence Summit is where Eden unveils the technologies, research, and ideas that will shape the next era of clinical intelligence.

Chief Medical Officer

## Felipe Kitamura, MD, PhD

_From Mayo Clinic to the AI committees at RSNA and SIIM, my career has been driven by one question: how can AI transform radiology and the future of diagnostics? That's why I joined Eden. I believe this is where we can empower physicians to deliver better care to millions of patients._

Enablement Manager

## Iván Rivadeneyra

_Eden's DNA is innovation. Mine is solving problems through technology. Here, I've found a purpose for both: building solutions that make physicians' work easier and improve patient care. That's what makes this work meaningful to me. When innovation has a purpose, technology becomes a tool for miracles._

Sr. AI Researcher

## Jean-Benoit Delbrouck, PhD

_I spent years researching radiology AI at Stanford, contributing to foundation models like CheXagent, RoentGen, and Merlin, and developing new ways to measure their progress. But research can only take us so far. Real impact happens when these advances reach the physicians caring for patients. For me, Eden is where radiology AI moves from research into the real world._

Product Designer

## Maria Camila Bravo

_I love that every day challenges me in a different way. I spend time with physicians, learning how they work and translating their reality into software that feels intuitive and almost invisible. What makes it meaningful is knowing that every design decision we make has the potential to improve someone's life._
